title: Precursor Timeline: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Local seal buying ran for two years before the fire with no response recorded.

events.text: Seals bought locally without a specification
events.knowable_then: The purchase record was visible to Stores at the time, but no check asked for a specification.

events.text: Seal changed; pump restarted without a leak test

items.lesson: A buying practice is a signal when nobody owns the risk it carries.
items.explanation: The reliability engineer role that would review it was absent [FND-0003].

items.name: Critical spares bought without a specification
items.measure: Count per month from purchase records

items.lesson: A missing procedure entry is a signal when restarts carry on without it.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002].

items.name: Pressure-boundary jobs with no checklist
items.measure: Count per month from the procedure index

items.lesson: A display-only alarm is a signal that the response relies on attention.
items.explanation: The gas alarm had no shutdown [FND-0004].

items.name: Gas alarms with no action class
items.measure: Count from the alarm list each quarter
